student_graduate.headline: Finishing a degree, never employed
student_graduate.why: The hardest CV to write, and the one people get most wrong by apologising for it. Nothing here pretends to be a job: coursework, a society treasurership and a dissertation are set out as evidence because at this point that is what evidence is. Education leads, and there is no summary of a career that has not started.
